title: Bilateral Bispectral Index, Asymmetries and Post-operative Delirium
official: Bilateral Bispectral Index and Asymmetries in High Risk Patients for Posteoperative Delirium: An Observational, Prospective, Exploratory Study
summary: The primary objective of the study is to describe the value of interhemispheric asymmetry (ASYM), during the different intra- and peri-operative phases, in those patients who develop or do not develop post-operative delirium (POD) during the first 30 post-operative days and postoperative cognitive disfunction (POCD) in the first 90 post-operative days, in a population undergoing head\&neck and plastic surgery with a priori increased probability of POD.

interventions.name: Bilateral Bispetral Index Monitor will be applied on forehead of our patients, before surgery begins
